meta.title: Withholding Tax Automation: not available on the Growth plan
gaps: Sign in as a Finance Controller on the Growth tenant and Enterprise tenant
Determine or verify the tenant subscription plan and compare the same user across plans
Locate and use Withholding Tax Automation to obtain an automatic withholding-tax determination
Observe that the capability is absent or refused on Growth and available and working on Enterprise
